articles.summary: Philip Rivers, who came out of retirement this week to help the Colts address their void at quarterback, is expected to start Sunday against the Seahawks, a source told ESPN.

articles.title: Bears place CB Gordon (groin) on injured reserve
articles.summary: Chicago veteran cornerback Kyler Gordon was placed on injured reserve by the Bears on Saturday, and the 25-year-old nickel corner will miss the remainder of the regular season after he sustained a groin injury at Lambeau Field back on Dec. 7.

articles.title: Cowboys keep CB Diggs on IR for Vikings game
